feed.title: URAN ETF Profile: Dividends, Returns (BOATS:URAN)
feed.summary: This article provides a detailed profile of the URAN ETF (Blue Ocean Alternative Trade System), focusing on its dividends, returns, and key characteristics. It outlines the fund's objective to track an index of uranium and nuclear industry stocks, its investment strategy, and financial performance data, including its dividend yield and asset allocation. The profile also addresses frequently asked questions about URAN's holdings, dividends, issuer information, and expense ratio.

feed.title: Former Three Mile Island nuclear power plant set to restart operations
feed.summary: Constellation Energy announced a deal with Microsoft to restart Unit 1 of the former Three Mile Island nuclear power plant, which was shut down five years ago. The reactor is expected to be online by 2028 and will supply power for Microsoft's data centers. While some community members and watchdog groups express concerns about safety, local leaders highlight the potential economic boosts and tax revenue for the area.

feed.title: Why Constellation Energy and Vistra shares are building on massive gains
feed.summary: Constellation Energy and Vistra shares have seen massive gains this year, largely driven by optimism around power deals for data centers. Constellation Energy's stock rallied 19.5% on Friday after announcing a 20-year power-purchase agreement with Microsoft Corp., which included plans to restart a nuclear reactor on Three Mile Island. This trend highlights how energy stocks providing power to data centers are also becoming hot artificial-intelligence plays.

feed.title: Nuclear plant Three Mile Island is reopening to power Microsoft AI's growing energy demands
feed.summary: Constellation Energy Corp. has announced a 20-year deal to supply Microsoft with nuclear power by reopening the Three Mile Island plant, which will address Microsoft AI's massive energy demands with carbon-free electricity. This move is expected to create 3,400 jobs, add over 800 megawatts to the grid, and contribute significantly to Pennsylvania's GDP and tax revenue, though it still requires federal regulatory approval. This development is seen as a major step in the energy and technology sectors for powering AI data centers while focusing on carbon-free solutions.

feed.title: Constellation to Launch Crane Clean Energy Center, Restoring Jobs and Carbon-Free Power to The Grid
feed.summary: Constellation announced a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft to relaunch Three Mile Island Unit 1 as the Crane Clean Energy Center (CCEC). This initiative will restore approximately 835 megawatts of carbon-free energy to the grid, create 3,400 direct and indirect jobs, and generate over $3 billion in state and federal taxes. The CCEC, expected to be online in 2028, will honor former CEO Chris Crane and aims to bolster Pennsylvania's economy and clean energy leadership.

feed.title: VPU: Utilities Are Surging, But I Found A Better Power Play (Rating Downgrade)
feed.summary: The article analyzes the strong performance of the Utilities sector in 2024, with VPU providing low-cost exposure to 66 stocks. Despite positive earnings revisions, the author downgrades VPU to "hold" due to its widening growth gap with SPY and identifies UTES as a better alternative with greater growth potential and a cheaper forward P/E. The piece includes a fundamental analysis comparing VPU with XLU, UTES, RSPU, and SPY.

feed.title: South Korea to Complete Two Reactors at Shin-Hanul
feed.summary: South Korea plans to restart construction on two APR1400 PWR nuclear reactors, Shin-Hanul-3 and Shin-Hanul-4, which were halted in 2022 due to previous anti-nuclear policies. The $8.8 billion project is expected to be completed by the early 2030s, reflecting a significant policy turnaround under President Yoon Suk Yeol, who emphasizes nuclear power for energy security and carbon reduction. Additionally, the article highlights related advancements in nuclear energy, including Centrus and KHNP's uranium fuel contract, progress in small modular reactor (SMR) development in various countries, and the U.S. DOE's findings on expanding nuclear capacity at existing sites.

feed.title: Report: Iowa ‘uniquely positioned’ to have carbon-free electricity by 2035
feed.summary: The Iowa Environmental Council urges Iowa utilities to leverage federal clean energy programs to achieve carbon-free electricity by 2035, noting that 64% of the state's electricity in 2023 came from wind and solar. The report highlights the cost-effectiveness of renewable energy over fossil fuels and points to Inflation Reduction Act incentives. It also criticizes MidAmerican Energy's "100% renewable" claim as misleading, arguing it's a "shell game" while the company still operates fossil fuel plants.

feed.title: Global Sustainable Funds Are Up Nearly 11% This Year
feed.summary: Global large-cap sustainable funds have seen an average return of 10.9% year-to-date, slightly lagging broader market indices. The top-performing sustainable funds, however, have achieved significantly higher returns, largely driven by investments in companies like Nvidia and Constellation Energy. This article details the largest and best-performing global large-cap sustainable funds, highlighting their strategies and key holdings.
